say:1:1710720001:1.text: The plan for Orion is in motion. While we wait for him to act... I must ask something of you.

say:3:1710720003:1.text: His life is fading at a pace I cannot stop. I've held him together with my magic for so long.

say:3:1710720003:1.female: His life is fading at a pace I cannot stop. I've held him together with my magic for so long.

say:4:1710720004:1.text: But divination and prophecy are my fields. When it comes to life itself, my knowledge is shallow.

say:5:1710720005:1.text: It cannot compare to the healing power you wield.
say:5:1710720005:1.source_cn: 这与你所掌握的近乎奇迹的治愈之力，不可同日而语。
say:5:1710720005:1.male: It cannot compare to the healing power you wield.
say:5:1710720005:1.female: It cannot compare to the healing power you wield.

say:6:1710720006:1.text: So now I beg you—look at him. To see whether... even the faintest hope remains.
say:6:1710720006:1.source_cn: 事到如今，我只能恳求你去看看他。看看他是否……还有哪怕...

say:6:1710720006:1.female: So now I beg you—look at him. To see whether... even the faintest hope remains.

say:7:1710720007:1.text: Though your memories are gone, throughout your journey, you've watched many people say goodbye.
say:7:1710720007:1.source_cn: 虽然失去了记忆，但在这一路的冒险中，你已多次见证了生离死别。

say:7:1710720007:1.female: Though your memories are gone, throughout your journey, you've watched many people say goodbye.
